Video showing the PS4 booting to the home screen and confirming installed games.
Video test: controller pairing and basic input check (buttons + analog sticks).
Photos of the actual two controllers (not just the boxes) and confirmation they are included.
response.reason: The photo confirms DualShock 4 controller boxes but does not reliably show the PS4 model/version, working status, or hacking/installed games. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
